Self-test cannot see a fault between run.title: Fault detection supports a stronger control proposition.
Self-test cannot see a fault between run.copy: DG32 is designed to detect processor disagreement as it happens. The customer benefit depends on the complete machine response, and must be demonstrated in an evaluation.

Six block groups on one clock;.title: Add diagnostic capability without redefining the control product.
Six block groups on one clock;.copy: The two DG32 variants share their control foundation. Evaluate the added computation only where the customer workload needs it.

The loop runs in hardware,.title: Predictable control creates a budget for additional value.
The loop runs in hardware,.copy: The design assigns control work to dedicated hardware. The remaining capacity can support other functions, subject to the operating rate and signal quality.

Mature-node silicon,.title: Target the physical functions around the main computer.
Mature-node silicon,.copy: Power, sensing and interfaces have requirements beyond computing density. DeepGrid’s portfolio addresses these surrounding functions; each product has its own development and qualification work.

Start on DG32-LITE;.title: Choose the smallest product that meets the customer need.
Start on DG32-LITE;.copy: Begin with the required control and safety functions. Add the separate compute capability only when the diagnostic workload justifies it.

Every gap is a deliberate sequencing cho.title: Product gaps are dependencies in the adoption decision.
Every gap is a deliberate sequencing cho.copy: Compare the functions available for evaluation with those still on the roadmap. A planned feature cannot support a present production commitment.

Closing the gaps.title: Stage the programme against demonstrated milestones.
Closing the gaps.copy: Design validation, returned silicon and added capabilities are different gates. Agree which gate must be reached before each commitment.

Evaluate DG32-LITE now if the drive need.title: Start a bounded evaluation before making a production selection.
Evaluate DG32-LITE now if the drive need.copy: Assess the current design against your required control and fault response. If essential analog or memory features are missing, make them explicit dependencies.

This form composes an email in your own.title: Start with the outcome your product needs.
This form composes an email in your own.copy: Describe the customer problem, timing and acceptance criteria. The button opens your email app with the brief; you review and send it.

Three of these answer most questions wit.title: Resolve the questions you can before the first meeting.
Three of these answer most questions wit.copy: Review product scope, evidence and the relevant explanation. Bring the remaining decision or evidence gap to the team.

Design, verification and bring-up are in.title: Connect the requirement with the team responsible for delivery.
Design, verification and bring-up are in.copy: Use the enquiry to establish the product scope, responsible people and the evidence needed for the next milestone.

One rail powers.title: Integration requirements affect the customer’s board and schedule.
One rail powers.copy: Supply, startup and timing choices determine what the equipment team can design now and what needs later validation.

Every electrical limit.title: Plan for characterisation before freezing electrical commitments.
Every electrical limit.copy: The published electrical values are process nominals. Measured limits must replace those assumptions before a production decision.

What a design can lock now,.title: Separate decisions that can proceed from those that must wait.
What a design can lock now,.copy: Use the defined package and interfaces to scope integration. Keep unmeasured electrical behaviour as an explicit validation dependency.

The fault path in ninety seconds,.title: Follow the failure all the way to the system response.
The fault path in ninety seconds,.copy: The explanation below connects detection to the protective action. Use it to identify the response your own machine must demonstrate.

Each failure ends at a signal,.title: Different failures need different evidence.
Each failure ends at a signal,.copy: Incorrect computation, a stopped processor and an invalid access are distinct events. An evaluation should exercise the failures relevant to your equipment.

Firmware fires the fault on purpose,.title: A protection function needs a repeatable test.
Firmware fires the fault on purpose,.copy: Deliberate fault injection gives an evaluator a way to exercise the proposed response. It is one part of the evidence needed for adoption.

A classifier can warn..title: Use diagnostics to guide service; retain a separate protective response.
A classifier can warn..copy: Condition monitoring may recommend maintenance. It does not replace the hardware fault response or establish functional-safety certification.

Four hardening findings set the shape of.title: Design constraints define where the product can compete.
Four hardening findings set the shape of.copy: Clock, memory and physical implementation limits shape the workloads the design can serve. Evaluate the intended application within those limits.

Six block groups share one deterministic.title: The design assigns a clear responsibility to each function.
Six block groups share one deterministic.copy: Control, memory, sensing and communications work together. The architecture below explains the proposed product behaviour and its integration boundaries.

Four decisions are frozen until first-si.title: Protect the baseline while gathering the evidence for change.
Four decisions are frozen until first-si.copy: The first evaluation should test the defined design. Additional features require their own scope and validation, rather than an assumption that the current evidence transfers.

Every subsystem is configured for a firs.title: The first manufacturing step is a validation milestone.
Every subsystem is configured for a firs.copy: A fixed implementation gives the team a baseline to test. Manufacturing and qualification outcomes must still be demonstrated.

All 44 signal pads are allocated,.title: Interface choices set the room for customer changes.
All 44 signal pads are allocated,.copy: The allocation below shows the available connections. A new interface requirement may change the integration scope.

Four gates run on the final hardened die.title: Release depends on all required checks passing.
Four gates run on the final hardened die.copy: The listed checks are gates for the completed physical design. Their existence does not establish that the design has passed them.

The core fetches every instruction,.title: Allocate computing capacity around the product’s primary job.
The core fetches every instruction,.copy: The design moves recurring control work into dedicated functions. Evaluate the remaining workload against the actual timing budget.

What firmware can count on,.title: Make the application requirements explicit before committing.
What firmware can count on,.copy: The detailed capabilities below define the current design envelope. Use them to scope the trial and the work still required.
